name: Editorial Fashion Motion Portrait
purpose: Stress-test photographic prompt factors in a production-like fashion scene with visible garment construction, motion, hands, depth, and lighting.
first_party_baseline_prompt: Create a full-length editorial fashion portrait of an unmistakably adult model moving through a quiet modern gallery corridor. She is caught mid-turn beside a pale stone bench, wearing a deep teal satin evening dress and carrying a small structured clutch. One hand lightly steadies the clutch while the other hangs naturally after the turn. Tall side windows provide soft directional daylight; a dark doorway occupies the near foreground, the model remains in the midground, and framed architectural details recede into the background. Keep the face natural, the hands fully visible, the garment silhouette readable, and the polished stone floor subtly reflective. Use an 85mm portrait perspective with restrained depth of field and realistic photographic rendering.

allowed_experimental_mutation_points.description: Add or remove low-signal quality wording without changing visible scene geometry.
Replace generic garment naming with construction details while preserving garment type, color, and material.
Add motion and fold-response language while preserving pose and garment identity.

provenance.notes: The prompt is newly authored for AIPF. Private source material informed mechanism selection only; source wording, prompt IDs, images, and creator-specific composition are not embedded.
